statement: The United States will carry out a military strike on a target inside Oman between 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-26.
resolution: TRUE if the US government, the Omani government, or two independent wire services confirm a US military strike inside Oman during the window; adjudicated 2026-08-28.
failure_condition: No US military strike inside Oman is confirmed by any government or independent wire service during the window, regardless of continued rhetorical threats.
